title: PF-1: Disclosure gate retired (no patent; source-available non-commercial license)
body:
**Owner:** Portfolio mgr
**Trigger:** standing
**Done check:** Site on preview URL only, repos private, no public pitch
**Status:** closed

Retired 2026-11-21 (Rowan, NO-PATENT-1 follow-up): no patent is pursued; all work is source-available under the Ultrastable License and commercial use requires a paid license. The dashboard `disclosure_guard` probe and its word list are removed.
